title: Adic object conditions for the explicit pushed tower
statement: Let X be Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], let T_n, i_n, j_n, hi_n and ai_n be as in [lem-weil-pbc-thickening-system-pushforward-functor], and let J be an ideal sheaf [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. Assume j_n is closed with kernel J^(n+1). For every coherent thickening system M [def-weil-pbc-coherent-thickening-system], the explicitly constructed inverse system P(M) satisfies IsCoherentFormalModule J [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]: its terms are coherent, J^(n+1) kills term n, and its adjacent map is the canonical quotient by J^(n+1) followed by an isomorphism.

proof.text: The source of each closed j_n is Noetherian. Closed-immersion coherent equivalence implies coherence of its pushed term and annihilation by j_n.ker=J^(n+1). On affine opens the range of the multiplication-image power is J(U)^(n+1), so the ideal-sheaf power and the image power give the same annihilation condition.

Since i_n≫j_(n+1)=j_n and both j maps are closed, i_n is closed. The formula for the kernel of a composite and the closed-immersion comap/map identity imply i_n.ker=(J^(n+1)).comap j_(n+1). Compute its affine sections to identify its multiplication image with the (n+1)st power of J.comap j_(n+1).

Transport the closed-immersion unit-quotient identity to the specified ai_n by uniqueness of adjunctions with the same right adjoint. Follow the unit quotient by i_(n,*) of the comparison isomorphism, obtaining the adjoint transition. Push this identity by j_(n+1),*. The ideal-power quotient comparison gives an isomorphism from formalModuleQuotient J (n+1) of the pushed term to pushed M_n. Its composite with the quotient projection is the explicit adjacent transition. The sequence successor lemma identifies this with P(M).map of the adjacent arrow.
